feedback.goal: Prove the closed self-improvement loop end to end on the tau-style benchmark: run the five synthetic tasks with deepseek-v4-flash through dsh headless in the pinned container, cluster the failures, run the governed proposer, apply its diagnosis as the human, re-run, and report the honest measured before/after delta with model, grader, and policy fixed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Baseline batch runs all five tasks with approval-bound model calls, deterministic grading, and immutable run-record ingestion; measured baseline is recorded.
The failure clusters, the governed proposer (docker runner, verified send_data_externally) emits a schema-valid draft targeting an editable surface, and the branch is archived.
The human applies the proposed skill rule plus the diagnosed prompt-instruction fix; the after-batch re-runs all five tasks with a fresh exact approval.
Measured task success rate is reported honestly: baseline 4/5, after 5/5, with the previously failing task flipped and no regressions on the four passing tasks; full gate stays green.

outcome.summary: Closed-loop demonstration completed with honest measured evidence: baseline 4/5 (task-005 failed goal:bookings), proposer diagnosed the exact-goal-shape defect plus a conflicting prompt instruction, human applied both harness fixes, after-batch 5/5 with no regressions and the full gate green.

what_worked: Every model call in the loop was approval-bound: two run-batch decisions (full set and subset) plus one proposer decision, each verified against an exact manifest or payload digest at the operation.
The container-hosted harness ran the whole demonstration: task agents and the proposer both executed dsh headless in the pinned image with the .env key.

The proposer's draft (drf-b7dc1420) not only isolated the grader failure (goal:bookings deepEqual vs extra fields) but also caught the e2e prompt's contradictory 'keep the same shape as initial_state' instruction — a real harness defect.

The applied change is two harness surfaces (skill rule + run-prompt instruction), both recorded; the measured claim is therefore harness improvement under a fixed model and grader, not skill-only attribution.
what_failed: The new e2e driver needed three schema/arg iterations before the batch completed.
Docker Desktop stopped mid-demonstration; the batch was relaunched once the daemon returned.
The first propose attempt hit the hardcoded --network none posture; the runner now takes an explicit network option.

calls.name: e2e-baseline
calls.purpose: Run the five-task baseline batch in the container and ingest run records.

calls.name: loop-stages
calls.purpose: Cluster the failures, prepare the sanitized payload, run the governed proposer in the container, archive the branch.

calls.name: apply-and-after
calls.purpose: Apply the proposed skill rule and prompt fix as the human promotion, then re-run all five tasks under a fresh approval.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Verify the full gate stays green with the applied change.

evidence.summary: Baseline batch (docker runner, deepseek-v4-flash, fixed prompts): task-001, -002, -003, -004 passed; task-005 failed goal:bookings (state kept extra unannotated fields). 4/5. Five immutable run records in .dal/runs.

Proposer draft (drf-b7dc1420, dsh-headless-docker, payload digest bce25636...): exact-goal-shape skill rule, verification against goal_state, and diagnosis of the conflicting e2e prompt instruction; predicted +0.2 task_success_rate with no regression.
After-batch (same model, grader, policy; skill rule + prompt instruction applied): all five tasks passed, task-005 flipped, no regression on 001-004. 5/5.
Full gate green with the applied harness change: typecheck, build, 129 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, benchmark suite.

uncertainty.statement: The applied change spans two harness surfaces (skill rule and run-prompt instruction), so the measured gain is attributed to the harness edit set, not to the skill alone.
uncertainty.resolution: The exact changed lines are in the commit; a future skill-only ablation can isolate the skill contribution by reverting only the prompt line and re-running.

uncertainty.statement: One seed per task per batch: the 0.80 to 1.00 delta is single-run evidence, per the project's own stochastic evaluation discipline this is a demonstration, not a statistical claim.
uncertainty.resolution: Multi-seed rollouts and paired comparison belong to the future evaluation tier (ROADMAP statistical discipline).

notes: Operator requested the e2e demonstration; three send_data_externally decisions (dec-e2e-run-batch-20260829, dec-e2e-run-batch-subset-20260829, dec-e2e-run-after-20260829) and one proposer decision (dec-e2e-propose-20260829) were verified at each operation.
The skill and prompt edits were applied by the agent on the operator's standing instruction and are committed here for review.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The new e2e driver needed three iterations (approval-before-manifest-digest, ingest object-vs-path, run-record schema fields) before the batch completed.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Driver bugs were fixed in-place; the fixed fields (semver grader_version, uri evidence, non-empty failure summary) are now schema-conformant and the batch is reproducible.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Docker Desktop stopped mid-demonstration; the baseline batch hit a stale daemon socket once and was relaunched after restarting the daemon.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: One duplicate task-001 run resulted; its extra record was not ingested, and the recorded baseline evidence is exactly the five batch records.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The first propose attempt failed because the docker runner hardcoded --network none; the runner now takes an explicit network posture (none for verifiers, default for model-egress proposers).
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Network posture is now a per-runner option covered by tests; the fix shipped in the same session.
